entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this VeloBand sensor. I'm looking at my order and I want my money back. This is ridiculous.
I can certainly look into that for you. I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. To pull up your account, could I please have your order number?
It's VF789012. And I don't want to be 'satisfied', I want a refund. Now.

Thank you, I have your order right here. I see you received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor 17 days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
I don't like it! It's uncomfortable and the data is useless to me. I don't need a reason, I just want to return it. Are you going to do this or am I going to have to speak to your manager?

I understand your frustration, sir. I just need to follow the proper procedure. For wearable electronics, our return **policy** can be quite specific, especially after an item has been opened and worn. For **hygiene** and **sanitation** reasons, once it's past a certain date, it might be **too late** to accept it back.

Too late?! Are you kidding me? I've barely had it for two weeks! This is unbelievable. If you don't process this refund right now, I'm going to leave a review on every single website about how VeloFit traps its customers with garbage products and garbage policies. Get me your supervisor.

Sir, there's no need for that. Please allow me just a moment to review the exact terms for this specific product. One moment... Okay, I've checked the official knowledge base article for the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. My apologies, you are correct. This item falls under our 90-day return window. You are well within the timeframe.
Oh. So you can do it then? About time.

Yes, absolutely. I can process this return for you immediately. I am generating a prepaid return label and sending it to the email address we have on file. Simply pack the VeloBand back in its original packaging, affix the label, and you can drop it off at any postal service location.
Fine. And when do I get my money?
Once our warehouse receives and inspects the item, a full refund will be issued to your original form of payment. That typically takes about 3 to 5 business days from when we receive it.
Okay. Good. That's all I needed.
I'm glad I could resolve this for you. Was there anything else I could assist with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
